history.name: WebSurfer

Common library status meanings:
- Checked Out: not on shelves.
- In Transit: moving between locations; not on shelves.
- Processing: being cataloged/prepped; not on shelves.
- In Repair: not on shelves.
- On Display: typically on premises and physically accessible; usually considered on shelf/available.
- Available/On Shelf: on shelves.
- eBook: not a physical shelf item.
No special contradictions found for these terms.
